title: Urugomero rwasenye ubwami
intro: Igihugu cy'imigezi itemba, ubusitani bubiri bwiza, n'uburumbuke butagereranywa - ariko abaturage baho birengagije Uwabahaga umugisha. Iyo inzibutso zazaga zibahamagara, barahindukiraga. Icyakurikiyeho ni igihano kikivuga nk'umuburo. Ni bande bari batuye muri uwo muryango wa kera?
clues: Twabaye mu gihugu cyari gifite umugisha mwinshi ku buryo inzu yacu yari hagati y’ubusitani bubiri bwiza.
Twishimiye imigezi itemba mu butaka bwacu n'umusaruro mwinshi wuzuye amazu yacu.
Nyamara igihe twahamagarirwaga gushimira no kumvira Umwami wacu, twahindukiriye Imana twirata.
Ubukire bwacu n'ubworoherane bwacu byatumye twibagirwa Uwabiduhaye byose.
Hanyuma haza umugezi utunguranye wanyuze mu ruzitiro runini twari twishingikirijeho.
Turi abaturage ba Saba, igihugu cyabo cyari kizwiho urugomero runini rwa Ma'rib.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
